is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii), An. funestus group, and An. nili complex (page 1, Abstract; page 4, Table 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Quantitative PCR (qPCR) was performed to detect kdr L1014F (Vgsc L995F) and ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S) mutations (page 3, 'Anopheles vector processing'; page 6, Table 5; page 7, Table 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 and Table 6 provide complete genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and sample totals for kdr L1014F and ace-1 G119S in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii across four collection surveys (pages 6-7).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected using human landing catches (HLC) in 26 villages in the Korhogo department, northern Côte d'Ivoire, and a subset from 6 villages was molecularly analyzed (page 2, 'Study area'; page 3, 'Mosquito sampling').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article providing pre-intervention baseline entomological data for an RCT under the REACT project (page 2, 'Introduction').

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are tied to the Korhogo area/department, with mosquito subsampling conducted in six specific villages: Tahouelékaha, Koungniguékaha, Lablokaha, Felékaha, Noufré, and Karafiné (page 2, 'Study area'; page 3, Figure 1 and text).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections occurred across four surveys between September 2016 and May 2017 (page 2, 'Mosquito sampling').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Conducted as part of the multi-site REACT trial project ('in the framework of a randomized controlled trial (RCT) in the framework of a project called REACT', page 2).

supplement.evidence: Genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and sample sizes for both markers and species are fully reported in Table 5 and Table 6 of the main text. The supplementary material is only referenced for indicators of quality control (page 3).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated vector bionomics, transmission intensity, and resistance mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii across four seasonal surveys (2016-2017) in Korhogo, northern Côte d'Ivoire. Genotype frequencies and RR/RS/SS counts are reported for Vgsc L995F (kdr L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1 G119S).
